name: @antv/x6 (v3 core)
summary: The maintained X6 line. The core bundles the official plugins and rendered the spike after adding tslib manually. Native Node ESM and CJS loading fail in the published package, so this is a browser-bundle-first migration with a packaging gate.
gains: One package includes common, geometry and official plugins
New animate API and virtual scroller
Browser bundle works after tslib workaround
losses: Native Node CJS fails without tslib

spike.scenario: 20 nodes, 20 edges, bundled Selection, panning, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: Vite initially failed on unresolved tslib. Adding tslib to the app fixed the browser build. Native Node ESM and CJS tests still fail; see docs/x6-v2-v3-audit.md.
